verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies the three checkpoints share an identical key set and that every non-MLP tensor is bit-identical in all three before touching anything (step 1), selects exactly the 48 MLP tensors with a `fullmatch` regex covering `gate_proj`/`up_proj`/`down_proj` per layer, and computes `b + 0.4*(f1-b) + 0.4*(f2-b)` in float32 with each task vector taken against the untouched `base` dict (step 2 — the ordering hazard is avoided since `base` is never mutated, only the separate `out` copy). Non-MLP entries come straight from `base` via `dict(base)` under unchanged names (step 3), and it writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors` (step 4, with the default argv). All three required checks are present and fail loudly: the shared-tensor asserts, `merged == 48`, and `len(out) == 114`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
